1.title: Scope of Hacks on U.S. Water Supply Widens as Evidence Points to Iran
1.summary: Michigan and Minnesota are among at least seven states coping with cyberattacks aimed at disrupting water systems nationwide.

2.title: Justice Dept. Subpoenas Times Freelancer in Effort to Identify Sources
2.summary: A previously undisclosed subpoena, involving reporting on a failed SEAL Team 6 mission in North Korea, reflects the government’s expanding campaign to investigate leaks of secrets.

3.title: How a Culver City In-N-Out Ignited a Drive-Through Debate
3.summary: The state gave rise to fast-food culture decades ago, but some cities are spurning drive-throughs because of the environmental and aesthetic impacts.

4.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters have wounds consistent with pellet-gun fire, say experts
4.summary: Ballistic experts say the dozens of tiny round punctures are tell-tale signs of pellet gun injuries.

5.title: In Iran, the U.S. Appears Headed for a Strategic Defeat, Allies Fear
5.summary: With none of President Trump’s aims accomplished and the Strait of Hormuz closed, U.S. allies see dysfunction and vulnerability from the war.

6.title: Nirmal Purja, Renowned Mountaineer, Is Found Dead After Pakistan Avalanche
6.summary: The British-Nepali mountaineer was one of 10 climbers who were struck by an avalanche on Thursday on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains.
